svg.title: Seven service failures converge on Riju's launch default.
svg.desc: Blank paths for address, welfare, clinic, market, school, traffic and flood services converge on one red-edged default pane. Cecil and Riju reach it together, and Riju quietly accepts that it is his configuration.
